# Website Quality Audit: Menu Page Description  

## Overall Layout  
The page has a **full-width, vertically stacked layout** with two primary sections: a hero section (top) and a menu selection/content section (bottom). The hero section spans the full viewport width, while the lower section uses a centered, constrained width (likely ~1200px max) for content, with grid-based menu item cards. The design is **mobile-responsive** (implied by the structured grid and spacing, though not visible in the screenshot).  


## Color Scheme  
- **Background**: Dark (near-black) for the lower section, with a semi-transparent dark overlay on the hero image to ensure text readability.  
- **Hero Image**: A high-quality photograph of gourmet appetizers (topped with red caviar and herbs) with warm, muted tones (browns, reds, greens).  
- **Text Colors**:  
  - Headings: White (for “Наше меню”) and a soft gold (for “камергию”) to create contrast.  
  - Body text: Light gray (for descriptive copy) and white (for menu category buttons).  
- **Accent Color**: A warm gold (#F4D06F or similar) for the active “Фуршет” button, creating visual hierarchy.  


## Typography  
- **Headings**:  
  - “Наше меню”: Large, elegant serif font (e.g., Playfair Display) in white, with a subtle gold shadow for depth.  
  - “Выберите камергию”: Mix of white (serif) and gold (serif) for emphasis, centered and prominent.  
- **Body Text**:  
  - Descriptive copy (e.g., “Авторская гастрономия…”): Light gray, sans-serif (e.g., Lato) for readability against the dark background.  
  - Menu item titles (e.g., “Канапе с сыром…”): White, sans-serif, bold for contrast.  
  - Menu item descriptions: Light gray, sans-serif, regular weight.  
- **Navigation**: Small, light gray sans-serif (e.g., “На главную,” “Главная → Меню”) for secondary context.  


## Spacing & Hierarchy  
- **Hero Section**: Generous vertical padding (top/bottom) to separate the image from the lower content. The heading “Наше меню” is left-aligned with ample space below for the descriptive subhead.  
- **Menu Selection Section**:  
  - Centered heading with significant margin-bottom (to separate from the category buttons).  
  - Category buttons (e.g., “Фуршет,” “Банкет”) are evenly spaced in a horizontal row, with the active button (gold) standing out.  
  - Menu item cards: 2x2 grid (or similar) with consistent padding (inside cards) and margin (between cards) for breathability. Each card has a title (bold) and description (light gray) with line spacing for readability.  


## Images  
- **Hero Image**: High-resolution, professional food photography (appetizers with caviar/herbs) that reinforces the “gourmet” theme. The image is full-width, with a dark overlay to ensure text contrast.  
- **No other images** visible in the screenshot (focus on text-based menu items).  


## Visual Issues (Potential or Observed)  
1. **Contrast**: While the dark background and light text work, the gold accent color may be too subtle for users with visual impairments (check WCAG compliance).  
2. **Button Clarity**: The “Фуршет” button’s gold color blends slightly with the hero image’s warm tones—consider increasing contrast (e.g., darker gold or white text on gold).  
3. **Grid Consistency**: Ensure menu item cards have uniform padding/margins (no “crooked” cards) for a polished look.  
4. **Loading Performance**: The hero image is large—verify optimization (compression, lazy loading) to avoid slow load times.  


## Summary  
The design is **elegant and thematic** (gourmet dining), with strong visual hierarchy (headings → buttons → menu items) and consistent spacing. The color scheme (dark + gold/white) effectively communicates luxury, while typography balances readability and style. Minor tweaks to contrast and button clarity could enhance accessibility and user experience.
